name: Plugin Card Widget UI
description: DOM structure, drag/resize interactions, and visual states of the draggable/resizable card that hosts all plugins.

dom.root: .card (position: absolute, border-radius: 8px, border: 1px dashed var(--border), background: var(--surface))
children: .card-header (height: 32px, cursor: grab, display: flex, align-items: center, padding: 0 8px)
.card-title (canvas element, pointer-events: none, user-select: none, text-overflow: ellipsis)
.card-close (position: absolute, top: 4px, right: 4px, width: 20px, height: 20px, opacity: 0 on idle, opacity: 1 on hover)
.resize-handle-e (position: absolute, right: 0, top: 0, width: 4px, height: 100%, cursor: ew-resize)
.resize-handle-s (position: absolute, bottom: 0, left: 0, height: 4px, width: 100%, cursor: ns-resize)
.resize-handle-se (position: absolute, right: 0, bottom: 0, width: 12px, height: 12px, cursor: nwse-resize)

interactions.name: drag_start
interactions.action: Record offset from pointer to card top-left → Add mousemove/mouseup listeners on document → Set cursor: grabbing
interactions.result: Card position follows pointer, snapped to 28px grid on release

interactions.name: resize_east
interactions.action: Adjust card width = clamp(pointer.x - card.left, 120, container.width - card.left)

interactions.name: resize_south
interactions.action: Adjust card height = clamp(pointer.y - card.top, 80, container.height - card.top)

interactions.name: resize_southeast
interactions.action: Adjust both width and height simultaneously

interactions.name: close
interactions.action: Fire onClose callback with card id → Card calls remove() → DOM removed
interactions.result: Card element removed from DOM, onRemove fired on parent CanvasArea

interactions.name: focus
interactions.action: Fire onFocus callback with card id → z-index raised to top of stack
interactions.result: Card visually on top, receives keyboard events

states.idle: Default appearance: dashed border, surface background, title rendered on canvas, close button hidden
states.hover: Border color changes to var(--accent), close button fades in (opacity 0→1, transition 150ms)
states.active: z-index at top of stack, box-shadow elevated, border becomes solid var(--accent)
states.dragging: box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), cursor: grabbing, z-index: 9999, opacity: 0.95, border: 1px solid var(--accent)
states.resizing: Resize handles change color (var(--accent)), cursor matches resize direction

rendering.card-title: Canvas text rendered via @chenglou/pretext createCanvas2(), 13px Space Mono, color var(--text). Width clamped to card.width - 40px.
rendering.close button: Two CSS pseudoelement lines forming an X, color var(--text-muted). Appears on .card:hover .card-close.
